citation.title: Identification of Differential Responses to an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test in Healthy Adults

population.description: 116 adults from the MECHE study (aged 18-60 at recruitment, screened on fasting glucose, triacylglycerols, HDL, LDL and haemoglobin) who had a complete OGTT glucose curve; title calls them healthy adults. Table 1 (n=116, mean +/- SEM): age 32.2 +/- 0.74 y, BMI 24.8 +/- 0.3. SDs computed as SEM x sqrt(116): age 7.97, BMI 3.23. Sex: Table 2 gives M/F by cluster only (57 M, 59 F by summing), so entered as mixed.

protocols.name: fasting_12h
protocols.description: Fasting blood sample at minute 0 of the OGTT visit, 'following a 12 hour overnight fast' (Methods, Sample Collection). Clock hour (08:00) is not printed and a 30-minute run-in stands for the single measurement (guide defaults); the 12 h fast is printed.

findings.description: Fasting glucose (time 0 of the OGTT) of all 116 subjects, mean +/- SEM; the whole group, not a cluster

location.where: Table 1, column 'Mean ± S.E.M' (footnote: 'Data are means ± SEM')

left_out.what: glucose at 0, 10, 20, 30, 60, 90, 120 min and the glucose AUC of the OGTT (Tables 3 and 5), given only for the four clusters, which the authors formed from the shape of the glucose curve; the whole-group curve is not printed and pooling clusters by n is not allowed
insulin AUC and fasting insulin of the OGTT by cluster (Tables 4 and 5); no whole-group value is printed
NEFA AUC of the OGTT and fasting NEFA by cluster (Tables 4 and 5)
C-peptide fasting and AUC of the OGTT by cluster (Tables 4 and 5)
oral lipid tolerance test: glucose, insulin, C-peptide, NEFA AUCs by cluster (Table 5)
triacylglycerol fasting by cluster (Table 4) and its OLTT AUC (Table 5)
total cholesterol and HDL cholesterol by cluster (Table 4); no whole-group value is printed
hsCRP by cluster (Table 4); printed in mmol/l, no whole-group value
resistin by cluster (Table 4); no whole-group value is printed
TNF-alpha by cluster (Table 4); no whole-group value is printed
HOMA-IR, whole group (Table 1) and by cluster (Table 4); beta-cell function and oral disposition index (Figure 3)
body fat percentage, weight and VO2max (ml/min/kg), whole group (Table 1); body fat is a percentage, the model's fat_mass is kg, and there is no weight or fitness series
